initiative.title: Hold the Stair: popping tower defense with real dice
initiative.body: A wizard's tower is under siege by swarms of conjured bubble-beasts that split when they burst. Hold the stair with a party of adventurers whose attacks roll real dice. Rules from the SRD 5e only (System Reference Document 5.2.1, CC BY 4.0), as Everglade uses. Pitched by Marc on the October 30, 2026 recording.

milestones.title: First playable
milestones.body: One map, a few waves and two defenders with real dice, playable in the browser and on a phone at openagents.com/realms/hold-the-stair.

milestones.title: One lane: motes to embers, a fighter and a wizard
milestones.body: Paths as lanes, splitting enemies, real-time turns and seeded dice.

milestones.title: The party: seven classes, levels one to five
milestones.body: Fighter, rogue, wizard, cleric, ranger, bard and paladin, with upgrades.

milestones.title: The layers: all eight bubble-beasts
milestones.body: Every layer with its resistances, shadows and detection, and the hulk boss.

milestones.title: The tower: three maps, forty waves, your own spells
milestones.body: Three dungeon maps, forty waves with a hulk every ten, and the tower wizard's spells.

milestones.title: Together: two-player co-op
milestones.body: Two players share the gold and each places their own party, on the room service.

tasks.title: First playable at openagents.com/realms/hold-the-stair
tasks.body: The first version anyone can play: one dungeon floor with a winding stair path, ten waves of motes, wisps and glimmers that split into their inner layers when popped, and two defenders to place (a fighter and a wizard with Fire Bolt) whose attacks roll a d20 against AC with crits on a natural 20. Gold from pops buys defenders; the tower's hit points are your lives. Tap to place on a phone, click on desktop. Mark this done when the page plays.
acceptance: https://openagents.com/realms/hold-the-stair loads and plays ten waves
Popping a wisp releases two motes; attacks show their rolls
It plays on a phone with tap to place
The realm is listed or linked from this project's page

tasks.title: Red damage numbers and misses over each target
tasks.body: Rising red damage numbers over each hit (Everglade's), MISS on a miss and a bigger number on a crit.
acceptance: Hits, misses and crits each show over the target

tasks.title: Long-press a defender to see its card
tasks.body: Long-press (or hover) a placed defender for its card: class, attack bonus, damage dice, turn timer. The hotbar's long-press rules.
acceptance: Long-pressing a defender on a phone shows its card

tasks.title: Play the first version and write down what to fix
tasks.body: Play the first playable on desktop and a phone for ten minutes each and post a note on this task with what to fix (pace, how much of the dice to show, placement), as new tasks where they are clear.
acceptance: A note on this task lists what was found on desktop and on phone
Each clear fix is a new task in this project

tasks.title: Paths as lanes with distance along them
tasks.body: A path in verse/terrain.coax carries distance along it, enemies move along it at their speed, and first, last, strongest and closest targeting are cheap.
acceptance: coax test verse/terrain.coax passes with targeting tests for first, last, strongest and closest

tasks.title: Enemies that split into their inner layers
tasks.body: At 0 hit points an entity spawns its inner layers at its spot on the path with their own SRD stat blocks; the split is an event in the rules log so replays and analytics see it.
acceptance: A test pops a glimmer and gets two wisps at its distance along the path
The split appears in the rules log

tasks.title: Turn timers in real time, resolved in a fixed order
tasks.body: Each defender has an initiative and a turn every few seconds (the SRD six-second round, scaled; try two seconds). Simultaneous turns resolve in a fixed order so the game is deterministic.
acceptance: Two runs with the same seed give the same wave result in a test

tasks.title: Seeded dice for replays and co-op
tasks.body: One seed per map so a replay or a shared match rolls the same dice, as Ice Cream Man is seeded.
acceptance: Replaying a map with its seed reproduces every roll in a test

tasks.title: Layers, defenders, levels and maps as text tables
tasks.body: Content as data an agent can write and the engine checks, like motions (verse/motion.coax) and set pieces (verse/setpiece.coax).
acceptance: A malformed table is refused with the line it fails on
The first playable's content loads from the tables

tasks.title: All seven classes: fighter, rogue, wizard, cleric, ranger, bard, paladin
tasks.body: Each SRD class as a placeable defender: Sneak Attack, area spells, Spirit Guardians and Daylight, a favoured enemy layer, Bardic Inspiration and a paladin's aura, using verse/rules/srd5.coax and verse/rules/srd5-combat.coax.
acceptance: Each class has a test of its signature feature

tasks.title: Area queries against hundreds of moving enemies
tasks.body: Everything in a 20-foot sphere and everything in a line, every turn, from a spatial grid in the entity system.
acceptance: A Fireball query over 500 enemies runs under 1 ms in a test

tasks.title: Levels one to five bought with gold, subclass at three
tasks.body: Upgrades are SRD class features picked from a short list; subclass at level 3 (an evoker sculpts spells around defenders, a life cleric heals the tower).
acceptance: Levelling a fighter to 5 gives Extra Attack

tasks.title: All eight bubble-beasts with their resistances
tasks.body: Mote, wisp, glimmer, ember, frostling, ironskin, shadow and hulk with their SRD stat blocks, resistances and immunities, and what each pops into.
acceptance: A fire attack on an ember does no damage in a test
Each layer pops into the layers in the design doc

tasks.title: Shadows and detection
tasks.body: Shadows can't be targeted without truesight or detection; a cleric's Daylight reveals them.
acceptance: A defender without detection skips a shadow; after Daylight it targets it

tasks.title: Hundreds of bubbles on a phone
tasks.body: Instanced bubbles (one mesh, per-instance colour and size) and particles for pops, holding 60 FPS on a phone.
acceptance: 500 bubbles hold 60 FPS (p95 frame <= 17.5 ms) in the perf run

tasks.title: Three maps with winding stairs, some with two paths
tasks.body: Three dungeon floors from the cellar to the top of the tower, paths winding, one with two paths.
acceptance: Each map plays a full run

tasks.title: Forty waves with a hulk every ten
tasks.body: Forty waves to win a map, a hulk boss every ten, gold between waves.
acceptance: A full forty-wave run finishes in a test with a seeded party

tasks.title: Your own spells: Wall of Stone, Wall of Fire, Slow
tasks.body: The tower's wizard (you) has a few spells per map: Wall of Stone across the path (verse/demolish.coax), Wall of Fire, Slow on a wave.
acceptance: Wall of Stone blocks the path until it breaks

tasks.title: A top-down tactical camera with pinch zoom
tasks.body: Pinch zoom, pan and a slight tilt in verse/camera.coax.
acceptance: Pinch zoom and pan work on a phone

tasks.title: Two-player co-op: shared gold, each places their own party
tasks.body: Two players in one room share the gold and each places their own defenders, on the room service with the map's seed shared.
acceptance: Two browsers in one match see the same waves and each other's defenders

tasks.title: The NEXT preview shows each beast's threat (lives it takes, speed)
tasks.body: Playtest #9041: NEXT shows only colour and count, so wave 5's glimmers (7 lives each) arrive unannounced. Show the lives each beast takes (a small heart count) and mark fast ones, from the waves table.
acceptance: NEXT before wave 5 shows that glimmers take 7 lives each

tasks.title: Smooth the wave 5-6 spike for players who hoard gold
tasks.body: Playtest #9041: a run that placed 3 defenders and kept 322 gold lost all 50 lives by wave 6. Either nudge when gold sits unspent at START WAVE ("322 GOLD UNSPENT") or ease wave 5's glimmer count; keep the play_through test winning.
acceptance: A run that places one defender per round reaches wave 8 in the play_through AI test
Unspent gold over 150 at START WAVE is named on the button's hint

tasks.title: Subclasses at level 3
tasks.body: At level 3 each class picks one SRD subclass from a short list: an evoker sculpts its spells around the party, a life cleric heals the tower a life a wave, a champion fighter crits on 19-20 (today's level 3), a thief rogue, a hunter ranger, a lore bard, a devotion paladin. Levels 4 and 5 shipped in hts-upgrades.
acceptance: Picking evocation at level 3 keeps Shatter off the party in a test

tasks.title: The defender bar fits a 390 px phone
tasks.body: On a 390x844 phone (dpr 3) FIGHTER runs into its card's right edge and SPEED 1's card cuts the 1 off. Seen on production 2026-10-31 (headless walk). Fit each label to its card (fit the cap to the width, as the other HUDs do).
acceptance: A test draws the bar at 390x844 and 320x568 and every label's width is inside its card
